requirements.statement: A command run with exec_session MUST lead its own session; on Linux its descendants MUST be able to start process groups and MUST NOT start sessions.

acceptance.then: setpgid succeeds; on Linux setsid fails
acceptance.when: a descendant calls setpgid(0, 0) and setsid

requirements.statement: end_session of the helper pid MUST kill every live process of its session, including one in a process group of its own.

acceptance.given: a descendant in its own process group
acceptance.then: it dies within two seconds on macOS, T1 and T2
acceptance.when: the owner calls end_session with the helper pid

requirements.statement: exec_session in a process group leader that leads no session MUST fail before the process changes; end_session MUST ignore pids 0 and 1.

acceptance.then: it fails with SpawnError::GroupLeader and the command never runs
